brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.

requirements.requirement: A storage box (an enclosed volume for storing things)
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full with bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full (full-depth hex bin) forming the storage volume, dressed with a heap of M3 screws (prop:1) inside; check_build ok, meshClash clear.
cover:0,0,0;full;top — a solid full top cover fitted over the bin; side faces capped with capOpenFaces caps (cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330) and joints locked.

setCoverMagnets on:true was refused NO_CHANGE with the message 'the cover already has its magnets in (a cover has them unless taken out)' — the fitted cover's magnets are in by default, so the lid is magnet-held shut. Note: the configurator checks fit only; actual magnetic holding strength depends on the magnets/printing the user fits, which it cannot verify.

finish.summary: Single-hex storage box: a full base cell with a full-depth bin inside, closed by a solid top cover whose magnets are fitted by default (confirmed via setCoverMagnets NO_CHANGE), side faces capped and joints locked. A heap of M3 screws sits inside the bin to show its purpose (hidden under the closed lid, as contents would be). check_build passes with meshClash clear.
